{{Top}}
{{Quote|I'm not much more than an interpreter, and not very good at telling stories.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Interpreter''' or '''translator''' was an occupation whereby an individual translated from one language into another. This role was sometimes fulfilled by [[Translator droid/Legends|translator droids]] or by automatic [[Electronic translator/Legends|electronic translator]] devices.
